clues: This busy city sits in the hills of the Cordillera region. It lies in the north of the Philippines.
This city stays cool while the lowlands stay warm. People prize that cool air in the heat of summer.
The United States built this city in the year 1900. It rose on the spot where the Ibaloi village of Kafagway once stood.
This was the only hill station the United States built in Asia. No other such post rose in that vast land.
Pine trees, orchids, and mossy plants grow all through this city. That leafy forest mix is the sign most people know it by.
